verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a glancing doc line saying you can 'write your own' providers, linking to /terraform/plugin, plus Registry docs saying anyone can publish providers. Together these imply an extension or plugin development path but never name an official SDK. The other items (CLI JSON output, MCP server, plan/apply) are not about SDKs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of named official SDKs (e.g. provider plugin SDK/framework, client libraries for the HCP Terraform API, language bindings), SDK reference docs or examples, any independent or hands-on corroboration of building against an SDK.
